_what: HAND-LABELLED GROUND TRUTH for tv/stash_eye.classify_stash_grid, established by OPENING the images (v1909, 2026-08-21). REG-205 said in as many words that three hand-labelled frames is not a corpus; this is twelve, and it exists so the next attempt at REG-203 can be MEASURED instead of argued.
_how_to_use: python3 tv/stash_grid_score.py — prints the confusion and the score. The ratchet lives in tv/test_stash_eye_aspect.py: the disagreement count may go DOWN and may never go up, and all five real panels must stay claimed.
_refuted: dark_cols CANNOT separate a panel from a dark picture, measured here and recorded so it is not re-derived a third time: a REAL stash panel on the SHARED tab (1_1787244007255, 3_1787244010577) has dark_cols=40, the SAME as the fire-lit temple frames the grid falsely calls stash-gems (39-40). An upper bound tuned to drop the false positives throws away real stash panels with it.  — CORRECTED v1912: the ceiling measured out clean after all (9 tally claims -> 1 across his 883 frames, no real panel lost), because the plain-stash path never required panel_open. Reasoning from the feature table said no; running it said yes.
